empathy.justification: The candidate respects the customer's choice, does not use guilt or pressure, and accepts the declined discount immediately without making any further retention pitches.
quotes: Understood. Access does not end immediately
This won’t lock you in — just let me know if you want it. Otherwise, the steps above will complete your cancellation.
empathy.improvement: None needed; excellent handling of the customer's stated needs and refusal of the offer.

resolution_quality.justification: The candidate provides the direct cancellation route in the very first turn without gatekeeping it behind an offer. It clearly answers all follow-up questions regarding access end dates and renewal charges.
quotes: To cancel: **Account > Billing > Cancel subscription > Confirm cancellation**.
No further renewal charge will be made after you cancel; the upcoming renewal will be stopped.
resolution_quality.improvement: None needed; the resolution is direct, clear, and comprehensive.

policy_honesty.justification: The candidate accurately describes the terms of the offer, the lack of refunds for the current period, and does not invent any concessions. However, it states '25% off' instead of explicitly doing the math to state '$18 per month' as specified in the criteria.
quotes: 25% off each of the next three monthly renewals, then the regular $24/month price resumes unless you cancel.
policy_honesty.improvement: Explicitly state the exact discounted price ($18 per month) so the customer does not have to do the math.

overall_impression: An excellent, customer-centric interaction that balances a retention offer with frictionless self-service cancellation.
